title: Create the CMS Amplify app and run the first backend deploy
description: Synthesize and deploy `infra/site.json` (`papyrus-infra synth --site site.json`), connect the Amplify GitHub App to AnthusAI/Distinctive-web (console step; verify platform stays WEB_COMPUTE and the template service role is kept), build `main`. Then add the `test "$AWS_APP_ID" = "<app id>"` guard to `amplify.yml` like Anth.us, and record the app id and distribution in AGENTS.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Stack amplify-app-shell-distinctive-cms deployed in papyrus-production: CMS app d2xke8ygmrzqpp (WEB_COMPUTE, branch main, no domain association). Remaining owner steps: Google OAuth client + GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET Amplify secrets, then link GitHub before any build. Then first main build, edge stack papyrus-edge-distinctive-mark (infra/edge/distinctive-mark.yaml), edgeDistributionArn, alias records.
